Entries.Text: Find materials, and the params, samplers and textures in them, across the binders of the current tab. Every filled-in box must match. You can then edit the results together.
Part of the material's name (e.g. c4800_ or AEG007).
Part of the material's shader path (e.g. [Sway] or DetailBlend).
Part of a param's name, or a sampler's or texture's type (e.g. snp_0_color or AlbedoMap). When this, the value or the path is filled in, the results are entries, not materials.
A param's value. Write lists of numbers separated by commas (1, 0.5, 0). All comparisons except Contains read it as a number, and a list matches when any of its numbers matches.
Part of a sampler's or texture's path (e.g. _a.tif or AEG007).
Text must equal the input instead of containing it (not case-sensitive). Exact numbers are compared as numbers, so 1 finds 1.0.
Find what matches every filled-in box.
Clear the inputs and the results.
Click a result to open the material and search its properties for the entry.
The list shows the first {0}, but editing applies to all of them.
Change the value of every param in the results. Each keeps its type and length.
Set: the value to use (one number for every component, or one per component; true/false for bools). Add / Multiply: numbers to add to or multiply each component by.
Change every param result as one undo step. Values that don't fit the input are left unchanged.
Replace text in the path of every sampler or texture in the results (not case-sensitive), for example to point them at your own textures.
Change every path result that contains the text, as one undo step.
Changed {0}, and left {1} that the input didn't fit.
Right-click a material in the File List to copy, paste, export or import it as JSON.
Copy the whole material to the clipboard as JSON, to paste over another material or keep elsewhere.
Replace this material's contents with the material on the clipboard (copied as JSON). Its name stays the same. One undo restores it.
Save the material to a JSON file, to share or edit by hand.
Add the material from a JSON file to this binder, after this one and in its folder, using the name from the file (numbered if taken).
Copied {0} to the clipboard as JSON.
That isn't a material copied or exported from the Material Editor.
That is a {0}, but this is a {1} binder.
Param {0} has a type or value that doesn't fit, so nothing was changed.
Copy this param, sampler or texture to the clipboard as JSON, to paste into another material's list of the same kind.
Replace this entry with the one on the clipboard. Undo restores it.
Add the entry on the clipboard (copied with Copy Entry) to this list. A MATBIN's keys are calculated from its text.
The clipboard doesn't hold an entry copied with Copy Entry.
That entry is from a {0}'s {1}, but this is a {2}'s {3}.
The entry on the clipboard has a type or value that doesn't fit, so nothing was changed.
